# Doppel 2.0.4
- New **Use with Claude Code** in the Creator Micro menu, and `doppel micro claude <channel>` on the command line. Doppel installs the codex-micro Claude Code plugin, turns on the setting the Claude app's Code tab needs, and keeps the plugin to its own Bluetooth channel, so ChatGPT and Claude Code share the pad by channel. - Doppel shows everything it will change and only goes ahead once you confirm. - A ChatGPT instance and Claude Code can no longer be given the same channel, and `doppel micro channel` now lists Claude Code too.

# Doppel 2.0.3
- Instances can now share a Creator Micro by Bluetooth channel. Run `doppel micro channel "ChatGPT Personal" 3` to keep an instance to channel 3, and switching apps becomes a press of the pad's channel button, with every app left running. Free channels can go to another app, such as a Claude Code plugin. - An instance with a channel uses the pad even when it is not the assigned one. `doppel micro channel` lists the channels, and `any` in place of the number removes one. - Rebuild each instance once from the Doppel menu to install the change, then pair each channel you use with this Mac.

# Doppel 2.0.2
- Fixes Personal and Veridue reinstalling each other's Codex workspace runtime. ChatGPT picks the runtime version per account and keeps it in one shared folder, so each instance's hourly check unpacked about 1.6 GB over the other's copy. That disk churn could make the Mac unresponsive. - Each instance now keeps its own runtime inside its profile folder. Expect a one-time download of about 340 MB per instance, and about 1.6 GB of disk each. - Rebuild each instance once from the Doppel menu to install the fix.
